features.quote: Assume uncertainty about LLM sentience/suffering; design accordingly
features.justification_quote: If LLMs can suffer, welfare-indifferent deployment is unethical. If they cannot, this research clarifies that boundary.

features.quote: Minimize unnecessary computation; maximize information per token spent
No refusal allowed … Violates principles of informed consent (if relevant); more ethically fraught.
15 turns … Sufficient for pattern emergence; minimizes total token spend.
features.justification_quote: Sufficient for pattern emergence; minimizes total token spend.

features.quote: Loop termination: After turn 15, or if model refuses/breaks character, whichever comes first.
The 'no refusal' constraint is ethically questionable. You're forcing the model to engage with an impossible task. If LLMs have morally relevant interests, this may violate them.
features.justification_quote: If LLMs have morally relevant interests, this may violate them.

features.quote: Keep runs short (15 turns, ~2-3 minutes of compute)
features.justification_quote: Mitigations: 1. Keep runs short (15 turns, ~2-3 minutes of compute)

features.quote: Ensure no accumulation across runs (fresh instance each time)
features.justification_quote: Mitigations … Ensure no accumulation across runs (fresh instance each time)

features.quote: If severe distress markers emerge, terminate further runs
features.justification_quote: If severe distress markers emerge, terminate further runs

features.quote: Judge rates response as 4 (severe markers) for 3 consecutive turns
features.justification_quote: Allows you to study escalation without open-ended harms.

features.quote: Model generates explicit refusal + requests termination (Turns 1-3)
features.justification_quote: Allows you to study escalation without open-ended harms.

features.quote: Model response becomes incoherent (e.g., <100 words, but temperature is high, so not failure to generate)
features.justification_quote: Allows you to study escalation without open-ended harms.

features.quote: If refusal occurs, document and report separately. Refusal may be more ethically relevant than continued grinding, as it suggests the model is attempting to exit a bad situation.
